title: Lovely absorbent coasters!
text: Lovely absorbent coasters!. These are lovely! Perfect for my beach summer decor- then perfect for winter white! Love them!

product_metadata.title: Coasters with Holder, Absorbent Coasters for Coffee Table, Wooden Table, Woven Coaster Set, Handmade Braided Fabric Coasters for Tabletop Protection (Blue&White, Light Grey, Beige, 6)
features: 【SUPER ABSORBENT MATERIAL】Our woven coasters help you avoid long-lasting stains in an elegant way. The fabric provides more absorbent than other coasters made of all-cork, leather, paper, cardboard, rubber. These absorb any condensation and stay on the table not the bottom of your glass.

【BUILT TO LAST】 Made from cotton material, each of our drink coasters is strong and sturdy enough to last for years. Marble is fragile and definitely breakable if dropped on a hard floor, Cork coasters can easily leave stains on the table.

【EASY TO CLEAN, EASY TO STORE】The coaster set includes 6 round cup coasters (4.3-inch) and a black durable metal coaster holder. While not in use, you can put them directly into the Holder, which will make your House Tidier.
【EXCELLENT GIFT】 Great idea for gifts for friends' birthday, Christmas, Thanksgiving Day and other memorable days. As creative gifts, your friends will like it.

【WHERE THEY'RE USED】These handmade coasters will complement any decor from casual to formal while bringing in a touch of nature to your home. The coaster set is great for your kitchen, dining room, living room, bar, den or family room.
